// regions: The database lives in Supabase ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) and this app talks to it over HTTP (PostgREST), so every query pays a full round trip. Functions were running in iad1 (US East), which put ~220ms of Pacific latency on each one — a page making four sequential queries spent most of a second waiting on the network alone. Running next to the database is the single biggest win available here.
// crons: 23:00 UTC is 06:00 WIB. The endpoint only sends the daily verse from 06:00 Jakarta time onward, so firing at 06:00 UTC (13:00 WIB) delivered the morning verse in the afternoon.
